text:
elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up from the delayed metering incident — ledger lag + token overcounts caused wrong invoices for ~1.2k accounts. I've attached the postmortem and a short action list. Need owners for reprocess, credits, and alerting by EOD. tl;dr: ingest backfill stalled for ~6h (ingest-worker OOM) and a retry loop created duplicate batches. See postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/delayed-metering-3071 :clipboard:
sam: I can own the reprocess + ledger backfill. Estimate 72h; will need infra help for burst capacity. Plan: run backfill in small batches, verify checksums, then re-run invoice generator.
maria: I'll own credits & invoice adjustments. Need the list of affected customers + their billing cycle. Can you drop an export to gs://billing-backfills/3071.csv?
elaine: Export is uploaded to gs://billing-backfills/3071.csv — added the account list and raw events. cc @kevin for infra quota changes. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Ack. I'll open an infra ticket to provision burst GPUs and lift ingest rate caps. ETA tomorrow noon. Ops ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/INF-9283
tariq: I will add metrics and alerts for duplicate_batch_retries and ingest_worker_mem_high, and update the oncall runbook with remediation steps. Target: end of week.
sam: Quick note on root cause — retry logic returned duplicate ACKs in a narrow window; dedupe key was missing on one path. PR ready but needs review: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/4822 - @maria can you test with the sample export once infra is green?
maria: Will test when infra is provisioned. Also we should backdate credits to the original invoice date. I'll need the invoice IDs — can you include them in the export or in the sheet?
elaine: Added invoice_id column to the export and updated the sheet. Action summary (owners + ETA): reprocess/backfill (sam) — 3d; credits & invoice fixes (maria) — 2d after reprocess; infra provisioning (kevin) — 1d; alerting & runbook (tariq) — 3d. I'll follow up in the weekly billing owners sync. Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BillingBackfill3071
ops-bot: Deploy bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bf-30711122-1 status=queued
sam: Kicked off a smoke run on ~50 accounts to validate dedupe. No duplicates so far. Will scale after infra green.
maria: Heads up — one account showed a tax calculation mismatch after replaying events. I'm logging a reconciliation ticket and will exclude that account from automatic reissue until resolved.
elaine: Created JIRA epic BILL-3071 and linked subtasks. Please add subtask IDs to the sheet. Also we need to schedule customer comms after fixes are verified — who can draft a template?
tariq: I can draft a comms template and loop in legal + support for signoff. Will post a draft here by EOD.
sam: Also adding a regression test for dedupe behavior into the ingest CI; will attach to PR 4822.
maria: I'll coordinate invoice reissuance and priority support for top 100 accounts; will post the affected list here once I reconcile credits. :eyes:
kevin: Infra ticket INF-9283 updated with required quotas and burst window. I'll validate everything tomorrow morning.
elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once all subtasks show green and the backfill is fully applied. Quick checklist to confirm in replies: reprocess done, credits applied, invoices reissued, comms sent, alerting in place. Leave short status replies here. :rocket:
